title: Official Statement about article related to Alibaba
detail: NexaVM hereby issues the following clarification: It has come to our attention that an online article has stated that Alibaba has invested in NexaVM. This information is incorrect. NexaVM confirms that Alibaba has never made any direct or indirect investment in NexaVM, nor does Alibaba hold any equity, ownership interest, or financial participation in the company. We respectfully request that any media outlets, partners, or third parties referencing such information correct the record to avoid misunderstanding. NexaVM remains committed to operating with transparency and integrity. For any inquiries regarding our corporate structure or investment background, please contact us directly through our official channels. Sincerely, Jack Chan On behalf of NexaVM
